title: Glovebox import: maintenance schedule by milestone
description: Mileage points with the work due at each, as an owner's manual prints a schedule. Format version 1. See docs/import/README.md.

$schema.description: Optional. Lets an editor check the file as it is typed. Glovebox ignores it.

repeatsEveryMiles.description: Optional. The length of the whole cycle in whole miles, for a table that starts again after its last milestone: a milestone at 10000 with 120000 here comes round again at 130000, 250000 and so on. Must be at least the highest atMiles in the file. Leave it out for a table that ends.

items.description: In any order; Glovebox shows them by mileage. No two may have the same atMiles.

line.description: Text on one line with no space at either end.

atMiles.description: Whole miles the vehicle has covered when this work is due.

orMonths.description: The vehicle's age in whole months at which the same work is due if the mileage isn't reached. Shown for information.

work.description: A name, and a service, may each appear only once in a milestone.

name.description: The work, as your manual words it.

service.description: Which of Glovebox's own service lines this is, if it is one. Logged work with that service then shows as completing it.
